summary: Implement the EKODI Autonomous Discovery Engine as the next evidence-driven capability layer: EKODI may autonomously discover improvement needs, formulate research questions, conduct bounded sandbox research and continuously self-evaluate, while production deployment and sovereign authority remain human-governed by the EKODI Platform Super Administrator.
approvalBasis: The platform owner explicitly instructed EKODI to define its final form as a platform that, within values and authority set by the Super Administrator, autonomously discovers, researches, evolves and verifies its own evolution, and to build that model into the system.
constitutionalFit: Implements Section 12 verification-first intelligent evolution without widening autonomous production authority.
Implements Section 13 open-ended evidence-driven generation evolution without predeclaring an official Generation 11 name.
Preserves Sovereign -> Autonomous -> Agentic -> Services authority order and existing guarded production release controls.
implementedCapabilities: Autonomous improvement-signal discovery before user-visible failure
Autonomous research-question and bounded experiment program generation
Autonomous sandbox research only when isolated, reversible, delegated, logged, preflight-verified and budget-bounded
Continuous Capability Certification for Generation 11 candidate readiness
Automatic fallback to Generation 10 safe mode when readiness evidence is incomplete
No automatic generation promotion and no self-expansion of authority
authorityImpact: None. The engine receives autonomous research authority only inside the already delegated low-risk and bounded sandbox scope. Production mutation, constitutional change and authority expansion remain human-gated.
scaleImpact: None. No new deployment boundary, paid infrastructure, provider dependency or speculative capacity is introduced.
rollback: Revert this amendment together with ekodi-autonomous-discovery-engine.js, governance/architecture/ekodi-autonomous-discovery-engine.json and its tests. Existing Generation 10 Self Automation and Evolution Intelligence remain the safe baseline and no production authority is lost or widened by rollback.
